item.title: Hemingway’s closure follows decades-long trend of shuttered Oakland bars
item.description: The impending closure of Hemingway’s Cafe follows the continuing trend of bars in Oakland ceasing operations. The disappearance of third spaces, such as bars, connects to larger shifts in college culture that leave students with fewer spaces for socializing. With fewer bars and a changing drinking culture, some young people are choosing not to drink at all.
